text:
maya: Quick sync: steering asked for a tightened MVP scope. My draft: prioritize hosted API + embedding-cache (hosted-only), defer tenant routing and org-level SSO to v1, include minimal email 2FA in MVP. Thoughts? :mag:

raul: +1 to deferring tenant routing. Biggest risk is per-tenant network plumbing and RBAC edge cases. That could blow the milestone. :warning:

devon: Embedding-cache is high-value (cost + latency). Can we scope it to a single namespace (hosted customers only) to avoid per-tenant plumbing? That keeps ROI and reduces infra effort. :gear:

sasha: Design note: if we remove tenant routing, we need a simple account switcher flow in the UI and clear copy for alpha customers. I can do compact mocks. :pencil:

lia-sales: Sales input: two pilots expect tenant routing later, but will accept an "alpha access" program if we define limitations clearly. Need a comms template for opt-in and a short SLA caveat. :email:

ops-bot: Canary created: canary-1798-embcache. Metrics: p95 latency, 5xx rate, embedding_hit_rate. URL: https://canary.redwood/internal/canary-1798 :rocket:

maya: Devon + Raul - can you estimate delta if we cut tenant routing? I need an updated milestone timeline for PM review.

raul: Cutting routing -> saves ~3 weeks of infra + 1 week of e2e tests. If we keep hosted-only cache, add ~4d for config + monitoring. Roughly net savings 2w.

devon: Agree with Raul. Also need a quantization QA pass; if latency spikes under load we fallback to quantized variant. I'll draft fallback trigger thresholds.

maya: Proposed fallback policy (draft): `if p95 > 350ms OR 5xx_rate > 1% -> failover to quantized variant + disable cache writes`. Canary window 45min. Anyone object?

sasha: Fine from design side. We should list UX degradations when fallback happens. I'll add them to the canary doc.

lia-sales: Please add a line in comms that alpha customers may see higher rate limits when on quantized fallback. We need to avoid surprise invoices.

ops-bot: Milestone updated: https://redwood/issue/MILE-402. Field: mvp_scope="hosted-embcache,email-2fa"; v1_scope="tenant-routing,org-sso,sms-totp".

maya: Action items: Sasha -> compact UX mocks and comms copy (owner); Raul -> new timeline + infra contingency (owner); Devon -> fallback thresholds + QA plan (owner); Lia -> customer comms template and opt-in criteria (owner). I'll update the milestone doc after PRs land.

raul: No objections. I'll include contingency buffer and rollback checklist.

devon: No objections. I'll post QA checklist and quant evaluation prompts by EOD.

sasha: No objections. Will post mocks by tomorrow AM.

maya: Locking scope to the proposed draft unless objections in thread by EOD. Thanks team. :lock:
